description: Change a task's title, description, priority, project or repeat; only fields you pass change. Status goes through taskhold_start, taskhold_complete, taskhold_block and taskhold_release. Returns the task. Fails on an unknown task_id or project_id (pass project by name).

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Move it to this project (matched case-insensitively, created on first use).

project_id.description: Move to project by id (null to remove)

task_id.description: The ID of the task to update

name: taskhold_update
title: Edit a task
